channel.title: US Top News and Analysis
channel.description: CNBC is the world leader in business news and real-time financial market coverage. Find fast, actionable information.

item.title: CoreWeave shares tumble as bond yields near 15% on concern about AI borrowing binge
item.description: Shares of CoreWeave sank 15%, while yields in its bonds blew out further.

item.title: How high inflation became a 'fact of life' in the U.S.
item.description: U.S. inflation has stayed elevated for years, raising concern at the Federal Reserve that consumers may come to expect stubbornly high prices.

item.title: Container ship sinks in Strait of Hormuz as Iran steps up attacks
item.description: Iran has escalated its strikes on commercial ships transiting Hormuz in recent weeks, as it tries to choke off a rebound in crude oil exports.

item.title: Treasury says largest U.S. banks let politics influence who received banking services
item.description: New Treasury Department findings may lend weight to President Donald Trump’s long-running grievance that major banks have discriminated against conservatives.

item.title: Fannie Mae sharply raises mortgage rate forecast for 2027
item.description: Fannie Mae just put out its latest forecast for mortgage rates, and they are much higher than previous estimates.

item.title: Berkshire Hathaway heads for 10th consecutive winning day. What's driving the stock
item.description: The conglomerate's Class A shares are on track for their 10th consecutive day of gains. That would mark their first 10-day rally since January 2018.

item.title: Trump to appeal order blocking White House from banning MS NOW, CNN and Politico
item.description: U.S. District Judge Timothy Kelly had ruled that the three outlets targeted by President Donald Trump can keep their access to the White House complex.

item.title: Bank of America hired 1,000 contractors to patch software flaws exposed by Anthropic's Mythos
item.description: Bank of America hired 1,000 contractors to patch software flaws exposed by Anthropic’s Mythos, offering a rare look at costs involved in defending against AI.

item.title: Netflix to lay off roughly 1,000 employees, or 6% of workforce
item.description: Netflix will lay off roughly 6% of its workforce, according to a memo obtained by CNBC.

item.title: Lisa Cook lawyer doubts Trump committee's fairness as president calls her 'automatic no vote'
item.description: White House spokesman Matthew Middleton said in response to Cook's lawyer that Trump "is performing his constitutional duty."

item.title: Trump's diesel dilemma — by the numbers

item.title: Here's the inflation breakdown for September 2026 — in one chart
item.description: The consumer price index rose by 3.7% in September, on the back of higher gasoline and energy prices largely due to the Iran war.

item.title: Social Security Administration announces 3.6% cost-of-living adjustment for 2027
item.description: With a 3.6% COLA for 2027, Social Security retirement benefit checks will go up by $75 per month, on average, the agency said.

item.title: BlackRock's Larry Fink warns a data center moratorium could trigger a recession
item.description: Local opposition to data center construction has been a feature of the midterm elections set for Tuesday, Nov. 3.

item.title: We bought SpaceX at $121. Here's why we're buying more at higher prices
item.description: SpaceX's Starlink, mobile and AI businesses are expanding. Here's why we're adding to the position after the stock's pullback.

item.title: OpenAI’s Sachin Katti to leave infrastructure role, stay on as advisor
